bodyHtml:
What This Is

Training a smaller student model to replicate a larger teacher model's outputs, enabling deployment at lower compute cost with minimal quality loss.. Achieved.

Deployed at commercial scale with multiple competing vendors. Revenue-generating across the industry. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Model distillation contributes to dramatic inference cost reductions as part of compound efficiency gains across GPU hardware, model architecture and deployment optimisation. Allianz Research 2026.
